name: Kerrno Vos
source:
The prodigal son of Voshim, hewn from the lower half of her bones and the marrow from those she kept.

Wants nothing but to see his Mother suffer endless embarrassment and anguish. Owns the Aspects of 'Mutation' and 'Unnatural Death'.

First Appearance: Ouroboros: The Sacrifice
